ann.ui_tooltip:
The difference in Luminence/Color that would be perceived as an edge.
Try lowering this slightly if the Edge Mask misses some edges.
Default is 0.063

The radius to search for edges.
Try raising this if using in-game upscaling.
Default is 1.000

Adjusts the Edge Mask and Corner Mask contrast for filtering unwanted edge blur.
Try raising this if text or icons become blurry.
Try lowering this if edges are still too aliased.
Default is 1.000

Adjusts the Normal Map weights for stronger edge blur.
Try raising this if edges are still too aliased.
Try lowering this if text or icons become blurry.
Default is 1.000

Adjusts the Normal Map depth for larger/longer edge blur.
Inputs are blur size parallel and perpendicular to the edge respectively.
Try raising this if edges are still too aliased.
Try lowering this if text or icons become blurry.
Defaults are 2.000 and 1.000

ann.ui_tooltip:
Edge Mask View shows the Edge Detection and Unblur Filter Strength.
Corner Mask View shows the Corner Detection and Unblur Filter Strength.
Normal Map View shows the Normal Map depth, used for Blur Size and Blur Direction.
Pre-Blur Mask View shows just the edges that will be blurred.
Post-Blur Mask View shows just the edges have been blurred.
